limits: One successful assembly, retaining all original shard/replay data. No concurrent benchmark, downloads, remote export archive, full-output copy, second run or automatic retry is included.
No actual assembly log is claimed to have been observed. The stage console estimate is derived from the unchanged code path.
Quota is shared and not reserved. The new launcher must repeat terminal, idempotency, package, source-binding and fresh filesystem/quota checks immediately before a single submission.
The unchanged assembly must validate actual vectors/logs/source/code/assets before publishing its manifest. This resource policy does not imply cache or scientific acceptance.
log_allowance_basis: Only four stage console files are created: assembly.stdout.txt, assembly.stderr.txt, assembly-<job>.out and assembly-<job>.err. No new32-worker console sets are created.
The unchanged driver assemble path validates and concatenates existing arrays/logs. It does not call LocalTransformer, tokenizer encoding, model forward or worker.run.

The driver main and dispatcher main each contain one final JSON console print. Per-record log writes go solely to chunk_log.jsonl, whose75706969-byte payload is already exactly counted. No per-record progress printing or log-body copy is present in the assembly path.

The16MiB allowance is aggregate for all four console files, allowing4MiB per file on average, far beyond the two normal JSON summary lines. It is a conservative planning margin, not a runtime-enforced cap or a bound on arbitrary dependency/scheduler error output.

The32MiB JSON,16MiB filesystem and256MiB extra contingency amounts are carried unchanged from the original full-run audit; only console allowance is scoped to this one remaining stage instead of64 encoding processes plus assembly.
original_envelope_guard: Fresh stat accounting sums max(logical,allocated bytes) of every already-materialized full-run file, adds16MiB directory/stat slack, then requires materialized+slack+872415232 <=2415919104. This retains the original2.25GiB total limit; the8GiB reserve is separately unchanged.
preserved_failure: The original1.25GiB+8GiB preflight stopped before intent/receipt/stage/job. Its files and failed transport remain unchanged. This new policy is versioned and does not overwrite that evidence.
purpose: Prospective disk bookkeeping for one canonical assembly only; no numerical, metadata, source or scientific gate change.
